definitions.gloss: mutual aid; helping each other; cooperation
definitions.explanation: The act of people helping one another, especially in difficult times. Emphasizes reciprocity and community spirit.

examples.japanese: {助|たす}け{合|あ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The spirit of mutual aid is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{助|たす}け{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Mutual help in the community is needed during disasters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{助|たす}け{合|あ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦{暮|く}らせる→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to mutual help among neighbors, elderly people can live with peace of mind.

notes:
{助|たす}け{合|あ}い is the noun form of the reciprocal verb ⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}う→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧ (to help each other). It emphasizes mutual, two-way support.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: spirit of mutual aid
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧: heart of mutual help
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{助|たす}け{合|あ}い: community mutual aid
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: a relationship of mutual support

CULTURAL NOTE:
A core concept in Japanese community life, especially emphasized during natural disasters. ⟦{共助|きょうじょ}→共助：22215_kyoujo⟧ (mutual assistance) is a related formal term used in disaster preparedness contexts, distinguishing it from {自助|じじょ} (self-help) and {公助|こうじょ} (public assistance).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}う→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧: to help each other (verb)
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: cooperation (more general)
